admission.justification: A warning about a successful operation must stay observable when the shared guard cuts its answer, including after logging changes.

applicability: String warnings in over-bound answers handled by the shared short-form guard.
conditions: The guard counts the recorded locator and final cut hint when fitting warning text.
Error text has priority over warning text.
A true warningCut marker survives a refit.
exclusions: Recovering full warning text when detail recording fails.
statement: The shared short form keeps warning text to the available budget and marks any cut, retaining the marker alone when no text fits.
